text:
alyssa: planning a small 'micro-probe' next week to hash-bucket ~5% of tenants into v2 (sticky cookie for 7d).
ben: sounds ok. what about quotas? we must ensure we don't double-count tokens for billing.
carmen: agree — surface it in console and let tenants opt-out. copy: "Experiment: v2 routing (5%) - opt out".
alyssa: billing decision: keep single quota; we'll shadow-count a metric routing.probe.v2.shadow_tokens for analysis only. no enforced split.
dmitri: telemetry: add attribute probe.name and probe_bucket to spans. metrics: routing.probe.requests{probe_name,outcome} and routing.probe.latency_p95{probe_name}. avoid tenant_id on high-card metrics.
nina-ui: UI: badge labeled "Experiment: v2 (5%)" on tenant runtime card. clicking opens modal with opt-out button and link to docs. opt-out must apply immediately and be persistent.
ops-bot: feature flag scheduled: soft_experiment_v2_2026 -> staging 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
sre-bot: NOTE: add kv isolation param. v2 uses different KV layout, mixing will bork caches. set kv_namespace=v2_experiment_2026.
dmitri: agree. also add a debug CLI: `redwoodctl route force --tenant TID --variant v2 --duration 1h` for SEs.
ben: alerting thresholds? propose: error_rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR p95_latency > baseline + 150ms for 10m -> auto-disable flag.
alyssa: we'll implement auto-disable. plus a manual rollback command.
carmen: audit & email: if tenant opts out, write audit event, send confirmation email, and show banner "You opted out of v2 experiment".
dmitri: sampling: probes get trace sampling 1%, non-probe 0.1%. also log one sample per 1000 probe requests with tenant_id for debugging.
alyssa: smoke-test: simple harness sending 10k requests asserting ~5% ±0.8% routing to v2 and no >0.3% increase in 5xxs. add to infra CI as optional job.
nina-ui: mock will be ready by EOD; using muted badge + small modal.
ben: keep probe_name short and static. no per-tenant suffixes.
dmitri: metrics retention: keep probe metrics 90d to compare baseline.
alyssa: action items: (1) i'll open flag PR + smoke test, (2) @nina-ui will push UI mock, (3) @dmitri will add metrics/alerts, (4) @carmen will draft opt-out copy & audit events. schedule 30m sync 24h after staging run.
ops-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2412 (soft_experiment_v2_2026).
alyssa: thanks all :thumbsup:
